newsitem.title: USA: Terra Q4 hurt by lower ammonia sales.
newsitem.headline: Terra Q4 hurt by lower ammonia sales.

text.p: Terra Nitrogen Co LP on Monday attributed its weaker fourth-quarter earnings to lower ammonia sales volumes.
Earnings also were reduced by lower sales prices for urea ammonium nitrate (liquid fertilizer) and urea (dry fertilizer), it said.
Ammonia sales volumes declined in the 1996 fourth-quarter as cold weather reduced fall applications, while the fourth quarter of 1995 experienced favorable weather conditions for ammonia application.

In addition, Terra said the late corn harvest in 1996 precluded fall ammonia application before the onset of cold weather. It said natural gas costs were slightly higher during the 1996 quarter compared with the 1995 quarter as cold weather caused natural gas spot market prices to spike upward toward the end of the year.
Terra reported fourth-quarter earnings of $1.32 per unit compared to $1.41 a year ago. Sales in the period declined to $85.3 million from $94.0 million.
